name: Neri
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Neri is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in Luke. He is the father of Shealtiel and part of the royal line connecting David to Jesus. His role in the Bible is limited to the genealogy, but he is important as a link in God's plan of salvation through generations.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Neri is listed in Luke's genealogy as the father of Shealtiel and son of Melki, making him an important link in Jesus' ancestry.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Shealtiel
keyEvents.description: Neri is the father of Shealtiel, who in turn is the father of Zerubbabel, a key figure in Israel's return from exile in Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Davidic line
keyEvents.description: Neri belongs to the Davidic lineage that goes from King David to Jesus Christ, confirming God's promise of an eternal throne for David's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Serubbabel's Grandfather Line
keyEvents.description: Through his son Shealtiel, Neri is the grandfather of Zerubbabel, who led the Jews back from the Babylonian exile and rebuilt the temple.

keyEvents.title: God's Faithfulness Through Generations
keyEvents.description: Neri's place in the genealogy testifies to God's faithfulness in preserving the messianic line through the difficult times of exile.
